constructor

  • @param onQuality Optional callback fired on each quality transition —
  • @param run Injectable model runner — defaults to the ORT engine.

quality

Current suggested quality — read by the resize/pixel-ratio path.

record

Records one frame's wall time and, every INFER_EVERY frames, kicks an async inference. Never awaits — the rAF tick stays synchronous; the predicted quality lands whenever the EP answers.

  • @param ms The frame's duration in milliseconds.

(module scope)

One inference pass: feeds the window (oldest→newest order via the ring cursor) plus the current quality level, then moves _quality one step toward the budget — down when the model predicts the next frame overruns, up when it sees headroom.

destroy

Releases the callback and blocks further inference dispatch — the dynamic import('onnxruntime-web/…') inside the engine would fire into a torn-down Jest/browser context otherwise. Any already- in-flight call still resolves; its result is ignored with the callback gone.
